svg.title: RNN model improvement roadmap
svg.desc: A tiered diagram showing improvements grouped by High, Medium, and Low effort with their expected impact on temperature prediction accuracy.

g.text: Tier 1 — quick wins (high impact, easy to add)

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Show me how to add EarlyStopping and ReduceLROnPlateau callbacks to the RNN model')

sendPrompt('How do I add time-based features like month, day of year as inputs to my weather RNN?')
sendPrompt('How do I implement walk-forward validation for time series cross-validation in my RNN model?')
sendPrompt('How do I implement a CNN-LSTM hybrid model for time series weather prediction?')
sendPrompt('How do I use an attention mechanism with my LSTM weather forecasting model?')
